title: DCP Coset-Subspace QFT Concentration and Leakage Bridge
claims: H^{tensor m} on |psi(s; tilde_A)> induces the exact product distribution prod_{j=1}^m cos^2((theta_j(s) - pi*z_j)/2).
TV distance from the s=0 reference delta_{0^m} equals 1 - prod_{j=1}^m cos^2(theta_j(s)/2).
Includes both the half-period constructive concentration control (prob 1.0) and non-half-period leakage audit.
